items.name: Big C's Power Plate
items.desc: In honor of a legend of strength and community building, we're bringing back the meal Court himself helped design. A protein and nutrient-packed meal to help you stick to your goals and see some gainz!

items.name: Chana Masala Bowl
items.desc: Soul-warming is the best way to describe this dish! Chicken and chickpeas are stewed in a blend of tomatoes and Indian spices, served with roasted cauliflower, and topped with a fresh and cooling Raita sauce.

items.name: Creamy Cajun Chicken
items.desc: This creamy Cajun chicken pasta features delicious blackened chicken, fresh bright veggies with perfectly cooked al dente pasta in a creamy, dreamy sauce!

items.name: Maple Pecan Baked Oatmeal
items.desc: This cozy pecan baked oatmeal recipe has notes of cinnamon, vanilla, maple, and pecans to make a delicious breakfast your whole family will fall in love with.

items.name: Take & Bake Creamy Cajun Chicken
items.desc: This creamy Cajun chicken pasta features delicious blackened chicken, fresh bright veggies with perfectly cooked al dente pasta in a creamy, dreamy sauce the whole family will love!

items.name: Blueberry Lemon Cheesecake Jar
items.desc: We took a favorite dessert and made it a guilt-free indulgence! High in protein and low in sugar, we use only whole food ingredients to make this jar dessert one you can feel really good about eating!

items.name: Chicken Pot Pie Soup
items.desc: All the comfort, none of the guilt! We made a classic lighter and fresher without sacrificing flavor.
